memory.title: Revenue join failure after customer_id schema change
memory.root_cause: The customer_id field in raw_orders changed from an integer to a text value. Because clean_orders still expected an integer, many order records no longer matched during the join. As a result, fewer orders reached the revenue model and the Revenue Dashboard under-reported revenue.
memory.resolution: Normalize raw_orders.customer_id to integer before the downstream join. Separate values that cannot be safely converted and monitor them instead of silently dropping them.
reusable_guidance: Check upstream schema changes before debugging dashboard calculations.
Validate join-key type compatibility across lineage boundaries.
Quarantine values that cannot be safely normalized.
Verify downstream dashboard totals after repair.

future_reuse_example.trigger: A later investigation detects a similar customer_id schema mismatch.
